description.en: Same as AddPartyNum_Important_Message_Back, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes -1 for both the fade and wait durations).
Number of members to add back.
Array of param IDs, one per member.
Array of position-lock flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-enable flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-lock flags, one per member.
Array of levels to set, one per member (-1 to leave unchanged).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Bring several important party members back in sequence without fading the BGM
AddPartyNum_Important_Message_NoFadeBGM_Back(3, charaID, ptLock, avaEnable, avaLock, level);
